answer_sql:
SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT dl.location_code) AS "how many different sites"
FROM contoso_served.dim_location AS dl
JOIN contoso_served.dim_store AS ds
  ON ds.store_code = dl.location_code
WHERE
  dl.is_online = FALSE AND dl.has_closed_store = TRUE
